name: Look up member and read balances
description: Logs into the CreditVantage servicing console, searches for a member by ID, opens their record, and reports current Savings and Checking balances.
goal: You are operating the CreditVantage member servicing console. Sign in with username 'ops_agent' and password 'demo-pass'. Then search for member ID 12345, open their record, and read their current account balances. Use the extract tool once for the Savings balance (output_name 'savings_balance') and once for the Checking balance (output_name 'checking_balance') -- transcribe the exact dollar amounts shown, including the leading $ and cents. Only finish once both have been extracted and you can see them on the member detail screen.

inputs.name: memberId
inputs.description: Core member/account-holder ID to look up.
